plan.title: Single-stage reverse auction with optional terms

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Enable eRFX event creation for the test company.
Allow the vendor to be added during event creation.
Configure the event as a reverse auction awarding the full lot.
Provide the required event title.
Apply the first available auction pricing template.
Add the specified product with quantity 10.
Set the requested delivery location for the line item.
Verify the delivery location was applied.

args.goal: open Terms & Conditions, add the clauses "Payment within 45 days" and "Delivery within 7 days", leave each clause mode set to None and leave "Mark all Terms & Conditions mandatory" unticked, click Done, and stop on the create screen showing the saved optional clauses

steps.note: Configure the two clauses as optional and leave mandatory acceptance disabled.
Verify the first optional clause is present after saving.
Verify the second optional clause is present after saving.
Add one QA vendor for the buyer-and-vendor flow.
Commit the immediate 30-minute event schedule.
Publish the configured auction.
Verify the event reached a published project page.
Open the invited QA vendor portal while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the event's auction bid sheet in the vendor portal.
Verify the vendor can see the first optional clause.
Verify the vendor can see the second optional clause.
Submit a quote of 100 without accepting any optional clauses.
Verify the vendor bid was accepted despite no mandatory clause acceptance.
Return to the buyer's event page.
Verify the buyer sees the vendor's direct response on the auction stage.
